answer_1.quote: Comprehensive experiments across various model architectures and scales validate the effectiveness of LACING. We observe significant improvements, particularly in free-form generation and visual hallucinations reduction
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual responses to visual inputs including descriptions, answers to questions, and multimodal outputs

answer_2.quote: MMBench evaluates fine-grained abilities of LVLMs, assessed with accuracy. TextVQA employs VQA accuracy as metric for questions with text within images

answer_3.quote: LLaVA-Bench uses GPT-4 to compare generated answers with reference answers. MM-VET evaluates LVLMs with GPT-4 in free-form question-answering. MMHal-Bench evaluates hallucinations and response informativeness, with GPT-4 comparing model outputs to human responses and object labels

answer_4.quote: We invited three human participants (all of them are Ph.D. students or Master students) to compare the responses generated by the models
answer_4.guideline: Principles of Human Evaluation for LLaVABench: 1. Correctness: Assess whether responses address the key points outlined in the reference answer and image. 2. Faithfulness: Examine any additional information in the answer to verify its accuracy and relevance. 3. Coherence: Evaluate the fluency and coherence of the responses
